$description: Hand-picked inputs, mirroring the Figma variables and styles in the 'cozy design system' file (8pN42b4cUOYKJnqcZ8D41o). Each entry's `figma` field is the variable/style name there. scripts/build.mjs turns these into primitives.json, semantic.*.json, tokens.json and css/cozy.css. Edit here (and in Figma), never the generated files.

hues.$description: Base colors from the cozy Figma guide. Each becomes a ramp with steps 5..99 (higher = lighter), keeping the base hue and chroma. Optional chroma/hue override the base.

pink.label: cozy pink
pink.figma: cozy pink (seed; the ramp is generated)

hot.label: cozy hot
hot.figma: cozy hot (seed; the ramp is generated)

peach.label: cozy peach
peach.figma: cozy peach (seed; the ramp is generated)

blue.label: cozy blue
blue.figma: cozy blue (seed; the ramp is generated)

deep.label: cozy deep
deep.figma: cozy deep (seed; the ramp is generated)

ice.label: cozy ice
ice.figma: cozy ice (seed; the ramp is generated)

neutral.label: cozy black, warmed slightly so the ramp runs toward cozy white #FFFDFA
neutral.figma: cozy black (seed; the ramp is generated)

roles.$description: Which ramp each semantic family draws from.

data.use: Numbers, times, inputs. (Proposed; the Figma guide has no data face yet.)

shadows.$description: Soft and low-contrast. Color is neutral-5 at the given alpha.

palette.$description: The Figma color variables, verbatim. Exposed as --cozy-* and the palette export.

map.$description: Subway-map style colors used by map/style.ts: flat NYC after the MTA/Vignelli diagram.

water.$description: flat grey-blue; everything outside the five boroughs is this color
